in_hebrew.name: פילידה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Philida is derived from the word 'pilah', which means 'to wrestle' or 'to fight'. The name Philida can be interpreted as 'Struggle' or 'Warlike'.

in_greek.name: Φιλλίδα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Philida is derived from the word 'philos' meaning 'love' and 'hippos' meaning 'horse'. The name Philida can be interpreted as 'Lover of horses'.
